title: 第一万一百一十一章 自在魔种第一万一百一十章 联手破封
content_zh:
器灵目光阴冷的盯着姬空凡。
他能清晰地感觉到，自己本体的碎片正在归元之力和造化之力的侵蚀下一点一点地发生着改变。
这种改变，不是自己的本体要被摧毁，而是本体中蕴含的无之力，在被无限制的削弱。
器灵和碎片间的关系，就如同生灵的魂和肉身一般。
虽然说器灵的力量，不是完全来自于本体，但和本体之间也有着极大的关联。
本体被削弱，对于器灵自然也会有着极大的影响。
器灵现在最要紧的事，已经不是去将姬空凡炼制成器，而是要先保住自己的本体，不让本体被炼化。
但姬空凡手中的碎片正在压制他的修为，让他每催动一分力量，便有一分力量被归元之力所吞噬。
九宫阵图在姜云粉碎八相和五道劫力的撞击下已经开始出现裂纹。
别说重新封印这方天地了，再这样下去，九宫阵图都坚持不了太久的时间。
“我还需要更多的力量！”
器灵就当着姬空凡的面，毫无掩饰的说出了这句话。
然后，他的神识便如同冰冷的潮水般涌出太初山，涌出镜中天地，涌向了一处这方天地内，还没有被战火波及的区域。
那里，有着四道身影正静静地站在原地。
千朔，伏照，钟朝宗，青岚！
这四位曾经在天地墟中也算是名震一方的太初强者们，此刻却如同木偶般，一动不动。
他们的双眼空洞无神，面容麻木僵硬，身上感受不到任何属于生灵的气息与波动。
因为，他们的魂中都是有着器灵留下的无之印。
这也就使得他们早就失去了自由，成为了器灵的傀儡。
他们被器灵驱使着冲锋陷阵，被驱使着与姜云为敌，被驱使着做尽了一切他们本不愿做的事，却连一声反抗都发不出来。

原本，器灵留着他们，是有其他用处的。
但现在，如果不用他们，那器灵也根本等不到那个时候了。
因此，当器灵的神识落在了他们身上之后，只是心念一动，那四道身影便同时颤抖了起来。
他们的魂中，那道早已与他们的生命融为一体的无之印骤然亮起，轰然炸开！
伏照是四人中修为最高的。
此刻，当那道无之印在他魂中炸开时，他那双空洞了无数岁月的眼眸，忽然动了一下。
那一动，极其的轻微，就像是被冰封了万年的湖面上裂开了第一道缝隙。
他的意识，在这生命的最后一刹那，竟然奇迹般地苏醒了。
他想起了自己是谁，想起了那些被他遗忘的过往，想起了自己这一生做下的每一件罪孽。
伏照的面容刹那扭曲，嘴唇微微翕动，似乎想要说些什么，但已经来不及了。
“轰！”
content_en:
Qi Ling stared at Ji Kongfan with cold eyes.
He could clearly feel that the fragments of his body were changing bit by bit under the erosion of the power of return to origin and the power of creation.
This change is not that one's own body is being destroyed, but that the power of nothingness contained in the body is being weakened without limit.
The relationship between the weapon spirit and the fragments is like the soul and body of a living being.
Although the power of the weapon spirit does not entirely come from the main body, it is also closely related to the main body.
If the main body is weakened, it will naturally have a great impact on the weapon spirit.
The most important thing for the weapon spirit now is not to refine Ji Kongfan into a weapon, but to protect his own body first and prevent it from being refined.
But the fragment in Ji Kongfan's hand was suppressing his cultivation, causing every bit of strength he exerted to be swallowed up by the power of returning to his origin.
The Nine Palaces Formation had begun to crack under the impact of Jiang Yun's smashing eight phases and five tribulations.
Let alone re-seal this world, if this continues, the Nine Palaces Formation will not be able to hold on for too long.
"I need more power!"
Qi Ling said this without any concealment in front of Ji Kongfan.
Then, his consciousness poured out of Taichu Mountain like an icy tide, out of the mirror world, and towards an area in this world that had not been affected by the war.
There, there were four figures standing quietly.
Qian Shuo, Fu Zhao, Zhong Chaozong, Qing Lan!
These four Taichu experts who were once famous in the Tiandi Ruins are now as motionless as puppets.
Their eyes were empty and lifeless, their faces were numb and stiff, and they could not feel any breath or fluctuations belonging to living beings.
Because, their souls all have the mark of nothingness left by the weapon spirit.
This also caused them to lose their freedom long ago and become the puppets of the weapon spirit.
They were driven by weapon spirits to charge into battle, driven to be enemies with Jiang Yun, and driven to do everything they didn't want to do, but they couldn't even utter a word of resistance.
Originally, the weapon spirit kept them for other purposes.
But now, if they are not used, the weapon spirit will not be able to wait until that time.
Therefore, when the weapon spirit's consciousness fell on them, the four figures trembled at the same time with just a thought.
In their souls, the seal of Wu that had long been integrated with their lives suddenly lit up and exploded!
Fu Zhao is the most cultivated among the four.
At this moment, when the seal of nothingness exploded in his soul, his eyes that had been empty for countless years suddenly moved.
The movement was extremely slight, like the first crack opening in a lake that had been frozen for thousands of years.
His consciousness miraculously revived at the last moment of his life.
He remembered who he was, the past he had forgotten, and every sin he had committed in his life.
Fu Zhao's face twisted momentarily, and his lips moved slightly, as if he wanted to say something, but it was too late.
"boom!"
